Booking Cancelled Without Warning — Staff Were Dismissive and Rude
Apr 2026 • Couples
I rarely write negative reviews, but this experience was bad enough that others deserve to be warned.

We made an online booking for this hotel and travelled from Hoi An to check in. The reception staff told us our booking didn't exist. When we showed the confirmation, rather than helping us, they shifted the blame — claiming we hadn't specified an arrival time (which was never required during our booking).

They had cancelled our reservation without any email, call, or message to us. We waited over 3 hours at the hotel hoping for a resolution. Instead, we were largely ignored. When the female receptionist did engage, she was rude, offered zero apology, and casually told us to find a cheap hotel 10+ km away.

This is not how guests should ever be treated — let alone guests who have already travelled to reach your property based on a confirmed booking. Our entire afternoon plans were destroyed.

I hope management reviews this seriously. One month across Vietnam, and this hotel stands alone as a deeply disappointing and unprofessional experience.

Very unprofessional and unethical business practice
May 2025 • Business
I have booked this hotel from booking.com, for three nights and when I arrived on it to check in around 6 PM.the hotel management told me that there is an electrical system issue of one floor level in which they have no available room for me. I demanded to look another floor or/ and another branch but they could not. After that I have to find myself and I tried to get in Agoda agency and found the hotel still has available room and booked it with the double price.
The hotel goes from the minimum $20 a night to $40 and about $60 during the hot season. 
That is unethical business operations. They should shut down the booking option if they have an issue and no rooms.
They should notice the customers before arriving…
Very bad… and upset

first trip to Vietnam
Oct 2016 • Solo
Wasen't sure what to expect on my trip to Vietnam. I have been going to Thailand for the past 20 years. Only stayed seven days. Four days in Da Nang at the Orange hotel. Three at Hoi An not far away. Can't say enough about the people and staff at the orange hotel. Owner and son went out of there way to make sure I was happy, and talked with me every morning at breakfast.. Da Nang was alittle to busy for me ,so I tried Hoi An. Much more what I am used to. Stayed at the NHI NHI hotel. They had bicycles and motorbikes for rent. Used both. Many tourist there to talk with.
